eyebrow: Built for the people on the ground
title: Three teams. One platform.
lead: Every team gets the screen it needs, and every screen shares the same live data.

items.title: Jobs done faster.
items.lead: The job lands on the technician's phone with the asset, the location and the checklist. They start it, add a photo and close it on site, so nothing waits for paperwork.
points: Work orders assigned to the right person in seconds
Asset history and checklists in every pocket
Planned maintenance that catches failures early
items.hint: Try it: tap through the job on the phone.

items.title: Safer sites.
items.lead: An incident becomes an investigation, then an action with an owner and a deadline, then a closed record with evidence. Every step is logged, so the audit trail writes itself.
points: Incidents, inspections and permits in one flow
Corrective actions with owners and due dates
A complete audit trail without chasing anyone
items.hint: Try it: move the incident through to a closed action.

items.title: Lower costs.
items.lead: See jobs, alerts, energy and cost across every building on one dashboard. Spot the site that needs attention, compare performance and cut waste before it reaches the bill.
points: Live status for every building and asset
AI fault detection that flags issues early
Energy cost tracked against budget, site by site
items.hint: Try it: pick a school to see its numbers.
